topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I can't believe this. I finally get some time to clear out the attic, thinking it'd just be old boxes and cobwebs, and what do I find? Someone's old life. Clothes, toys, even letters. It's like they just vanished and left everything behind. Now I'm stuck sorting through this mess, trying to figure out if I should keep it, sell it, or just throw it all away. But what if it's important to someone? I don't have time for this. I need to get this house in order, and this is just delaying everything. Why couldn't they have just taken their junk with them?
